newsitem.title: USA: YPF selling Canadon Seco, Chile seeks March crude.
newsitem.headline: YPF selling Canadon Seco, Chile seeks March crude.

text.p: Argentina's YPF is selling 950,000 barrels of Canadon Seco crude for loading February 24-25, trade sources said on Tuesday.

The formerly state-controlled oil company is asking a discount of $1.95 a barrel to benchmark West Texas Intermediate for loading onto a large vessel, or a $2.35 a barrel discount for loading onto smaller vessels, they said.
The loading terminal is Caleta Olivia on the south Atlantic coast.
Canadon Seco is a waxy crude with an API gravity of 25.7 degrees and 0.23 percent sulfur.
Previous buyers include Brazil's state-owned Petrobras, U.S. Gulf Coast refiners and traders.
Elsewhere in the region, Chile's state-owned oil company Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) is seeking 960,000 barrels of crude for delivery March 10, trade sources said.
Bids will be received January 23, the sources said.
